scope: proportionate read-only review of three synthetic delivery helpers; no helper execution, Provider call, product change, or installation claim

files.finding: Buffer and process are explicit node:buffer and node:process imports; staged blobs are obtained with exact git index paths and compared byte-for-byte, with documented CRLF normalization only for staged Markdown.

process is an explicit node:process import. Every bundled src/** load is intercepted and read with git show from exact commit 8154d0e09fc95014b8d205f8ed70c0028557208e. Synthetic run/data-set identity, READY state, schema 15, integrity, foreign keys, active assistant, real production lease, before/after domain counts, one DRAFT_PROPOSAL, store close and lease release are checked. No source provider is called.

The source must be an owned top-level mashiro-f1-e2e temp root with matching run marker and successful seed/verify results. SQLite is opened read-only, integrity/schema/foreign keys and nine table counts are checked, symlinks and special entries are rejected, copied bytes are hashed, non-empty WAL/SHM is rejected, the target is a fresh mkdtemp scene, production initialization creates the data-set marker under a real lease, and the lease is released. The source path is never opened for write.

limitations: This review relies on the recorded successful receipts for the one-time mutations and does not rerun either seed helper.

The full-domain converter bundles the then-current production initializer rather than reconstructing that initializer from the baseline commit; its output is therefore a synthetic installation input, not evidence that the old installer created the data set.

The proposal helper records the exact loaded src file list but does not hard-code an expected dependency list; the recorded 14-file list was inspected and every src load is nevertheless git-show pinned.
